body:
W008 converts captured GDS and selected layer/unit policies into an immutable local geometry draft, a reproducible exact base partition, and complete multi-occupant coverage. Public constructors and canonical wire validate the result against its captured input. External body context remains separate from local geometry.

Independent pre-merge review found no new findings and zero remaining must-fix issues; IR-01 and CR-01 are closed. [Review report](https://github.com/LucianoHoult/Layauto/blob/eb15a666010cf7f5fa82c97880a4d0e8f023fa8f/docs/tasks/W008/independent-premerge-review.md) and [PM receipt](https://github.com/LucianoHoult/Layauto/blob/eb15a666010cf7f5fa82c97880a4d0e8f023fa8f/docs/tasks/W008/pm-receipt.json).

Validation: final execution records show 730 tests on each of Python 3.10/3.11, strict typing over 40 modules, fresh packages and clean installs. PM and the independent pre-merge session each ran all 730 tests and typing on Python 3.12; source manifests and package bytes match. Targeted combined validation will run on the actual main merge commit.

Scope remains base geometry/occupancy. Full technology coordinates, physical connectivity/body/extraction, baseline publication, no-change and Stage 6 remain later work. U06 production inputs without external tapcell context remain a recorded requirement. Extreme-overlap resource bounds and real EDA/PDK are not verified.
title: Add exact geometry drafts and base occupancy (W008)
